# Front matter

The YAML block at the top of a document sets its title, date, author and description.

## In a `.qmd`

```yaml
---
title: "Station coverage"
date: today
date-format: "YYYY.MM.DD"
author: "David Sestu"
---
```

## In a marimo notebook

Add a markdown cell that holds only the YAML block. It stays editable in the marimo editor, and the renderer lifts it into the front matter and leaves it out of the page. The ```` ```yaml ```` fence is optional.

## When it is missing

The renderer adds a generic block to the source file: a title from the file name, today's date, and commented-out `author`, `description` and `categories` lines to fill in.
